paragraphs.source_en: “It is time for this humble monk to take his leave as well. From here I shall pass through Hayakawaguchi and spend the night at Yumoto. Tomorrow I shall pay my respects to the Gongen at Hakone, then go on to Sunpu.”

units.source_en: “It is time for this humble monk to take his leave as well.
From here I shall pass through Hayakawaguchi and spend the night at Yumoto. Tomorrow I shall pay my respects to the Gongen at Hakone, then go on to Sunpu.”
units.source_zh: 从这里经早川口在汤本住一宿，明日去箱根拜权现，再去骏府。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “贫僧也该告辞了。从这里经早川口在汤本住一宿，明日去箱根拜权现，再去骏府。”

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing that he had no wish to say anything more, Ujinao signaled with his eyes to the foot soldier who had escorted Zuifeng there. “You may go without concern, Reverend.”

units.source_en: Seeing that he had no wish to say anything more, Ujinao signaled with his eyes to the foot soldier who had escorted Zuifeng there. “You may go without concern, Reverend.”
units.source_zh: 氏直看到他已无意多言，便朝押解随风来这里的步卒使了个眼色，“大师且放心去吧。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 氏直看到他已无意多言，便朝押解随风来这里的步卒使了个眼色，“大师且放心去吧。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Let the heart and circumstances guide us.” Ujinao said.

units.source_en: “Let the heart and circumstances guide us.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Very well. I shall repeat your words to Lord Tokugawa exactly as you spoke them—and that, too, will be for the sake of the Hōjō clan!” With that, Zuifeng walked away, followed by the two foot soldiers who had just untied him. Ujinao watched them go without taking his eyes off them.

units.source_zh: 随风说罢，走了开去，刚才给他解开绳子的两个步卒跟了上去。

units.source_en: Ujinao watched them go without taking his eyes off them.
units.source_zh: 氏直目不转睛目送着他们。

paragraphs.source_zh: “好。我会把大人这句话原封不动告诉德川大人，便也是为了北条氏！”随风说罢，走了开去，刚才给他解开绳子的两个步卒跟了上去。氏直目不转睛目送着他们。
